programme.desc: 2000: Leeds United v Liverpool A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, Leeds take on Liverpool at Elland Road in a captivating seven-goal thriller back in 2000 that saw Mark Viduka score four times.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2012: Manchester City v Queens Park Rangers A chance to relive a Premier League classic. Here, arguably the Premier League's most memorable moment, as Manchester City take on Queens Park Rangers on the final day of the 2011-12 season.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: Crystal Palace v Liverpool (3-3) A chance to relive a classic clash from the Premier League. Here, Crystal Palace host Liverpool at Selhurst Park towards the end of the 2013-14 season in a vital match in the title race.
programme.title: Premier League Archive

programme.desc: 2009: Manchester United v Manchester City Man Utd and Man City meet in a memorable derby encounter that produced seven goals and went to the final minute.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2020/21 A selection of incredible strikes during the 2020-2021 Premier League season, including stunners from Mohamed Salah, Mason Mount, Kevin De Bruyne and many more.
programme.title: Best Premier League Goals

programme.desc: Thierry Henry In the final episode of PL100 we sit down with Arsenal legend Thierry Henry who scored 175 goals in 258 appearances in the English Premier League.
programme.title: Premier League 100

programme.desc: Ruud van Nistelrooy A profile of former Dutch international and Manchester United striker Ruud van Nistelrooy, who scored 95 goals in 150 Premier League appearances for the Red Devils before moving to Real Madrid.
programme.title: Premier League Legends

programme.desc: 2012: Wolverhampton Wanderers v West Bromwich Albion A chance to relive a classic match from the Premier League. Here, Black Country rivals Wolves and West Brom clash at Molineux back in 2012 in a memorable match for the Baggies.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2009: Burnley v Manchester United A chance to relive a classic Premier League match. Here, Burnley take on Manchester United at Turf Moor in August 2009 on what would be a memorable evening for the Clarets.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2013: Cardiff City v Manchester City Relive some classic action from the Premier League archive. Here, Cardiff meet Man City on a memorable afternoon in south Wales back in 2013.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2001: Arsenal v Charlton Athletic A chance to relive a classic match from the Premier League. Here, Arsenal take on Charlton Athletic at Highbury back in 2001 on a memorable afternoon for the Addicks.
programme.title: The Premier League's Greatest Games

programme.desc: 2021/22 A compilation of breathtaking goals during the 2021-2022 Premier League season, including long shots, solo goals and bicycle kicks from some of the top flight's finest footballers.
programme.title: Best Premier League Goals

programme.desc: Paul Ince Series profiling some of the greatest players to grace the Barclays Premier League. Here the focus is on former Manchester United and Liverpool midfielder Paul Ince.
programme.title: Premier League Legends

programme.desc: Teddy Sheringham A profile of former Tottenham and Manchester United striker Teddy Sheringham. The former England international was part of the Red Devils' treble-winning season in 1999.
